rules.title: Plain test functions
rules.text: Write tests as plain test_ functions with fixtures. Do not add test classes to new code.

rules.title: Named parametrization
rules.text: Use pytest.mark.parametrize with pytest.param(..., id=...) for named cases.

rules.title: Fixtures in conftest
rules.text: Share fixtures through conftest.py and keep them small and composable.

rules.title: tmp_path and monkeypatch
rules.text: Use tmp_path for files and monkeypatch for environment and attributes.

rules.title: usefixtures for side effects
rules.text: Use pytest.mark.usefixtures for fixtures a test needs but never reads.

rules.title: Strict markers
rules.text: Register custom markers in config and run with --strict-markers.

rules.title: One async runner
rules.text: For async tests use a single runner such as anyio, not a mix of plugins.

rules.title: Snapshot big structures
rules.text: Use syrupy snapshots for large expected structures instead of building them inline.

rules.title: Warnings as errors
rules.text: Treat warnings as errors with filterwarnings = error, adding narrow exceptions.

rules.title: Typed tests
rules.text: Annotate test function parameters and prefer concrete types over Any.

rules.title: Run a subset
rules.text: Run a specific file or a -k expression instead of the whole suite to check one change.
